description: Lock file pinning the official ACP/A2A specification snapshots used by the adapters. Upgrading a protocol requires explicitly updating this file, the generated bindings, and the conformance fixtures in the same change.

acp.notes: schema/v2 is unstable and is NOT adopted.

a2a.notes: protobuf JSON mapping is used for the JSON-RPC binding; specification/json/README.md is an entry note only and does not replace the proto.
